newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Norilsk says no ADR before stabilisation.
newsitem.headline: Russia Norilsk says no ADR before stabilisation.

text.p: Russian mining and smelting company RAO Norilsky Nickel said on Friday it would issue American Depositary Receipts only after its financial situation had stabilised.

"It (the ADR issue) could happen in half a year's time, in a year's time...We plan to do it when the enterprise has achieved financial stabilisation," Norilsk first deputy chief executive Dmitry Zelenin told Reuters.
He said Norilsk could see stabilisation in 1998, adding, "1998 will be non-loss making."
Norilsk officials said last month that the date of the ADR issue, originally planned for July, could be changed due to poor financial results.
Norilsk, one of the world's most important producers of nickel, platinum, palladium and other metals, had a 1996 consolidated loss of 3.29 trillion roubles according to Russian standards.
